full_workspace_cycle16.note: cycle 16 left 2 failing packages/ui theme-css.test.ts drift tests. My cycle-16 diagnosis (prettier trailing-whitespace) was WRONG — cycle 17 found the real cause: CRLF line endings (see full_workspace_cycle17).

full_workspace_cycle17.note: ALL GREEN after the cycle-17 CRLF fix. The 2 cycle-16 failures were a cross-platform DETERMINISM flake, not a content bug: core.autocrlf=true + no .gitattributes => the LF-committed noor-themes.css/noor-tokens.css were checked out CRLF on Windows; the generator emits LF; byte-exact toBe() failed. Green in CI (Linux/LF), red on Windows. Fixed at root cause with a repo `.gitattributes` (`* text=auto eol=lf` + binary markers) — NOT by weakening the drift test or hand-editing the generated CSS. git status stays clean (only .gitattributes added; the other 670 CRLF working files normalise against the LF index).
